comment: Which picture covers which spoken line. clip: = an existing Vertex render in clips/. flow: = a Google Flow generation in films/flow/clips/. gfx: = an animated panel. A list splits the beat evenly across those shots. An object picks WHICH seconds play: {ref, from, to} plays from..to stretched to the line (keep it under 1.3x); {ref, from} plays from there at normal speed.
